name: AISchemaGen – AI Schema Generator
author: digitalstorks

sections.description:
AISchemaGen automatically generates, validates, and manages JSON-LD structured data for any WordPress site. Click Generate — the AI reads your content and creates accurate schema markup in seconds.

No manual JSON-LD writing. No schema expertise required. Connects to the AISchemaGen API using your free API key and handles everything automatically.

📖 Full Documentation at aischemagen.com/docs

Why Schema Markup Matters

Schema markup (structured data) helps search engines understand your content. When implemented correctly, it enables rich results in Google such as:

  • Star ratings and review snippets
  • Product prices and availability
  • FAQ accordions directly in search results
  • Recipe cards with cook time and calories
  • Event dates and locations
  • Breadcrumb navigation trails

AISchemaGen generates all of these automatically — no JSON-LD knowledge required.

One Click. Valid Schema. Every Time.

AISchemaGen uses AI to analyze your content and generate accurate schema markup automatically. With one click, the plugin creates structured data in JSON-LD format and inserts it directly into your page, validated against Google’s requirements.

Get Started in Seconds

  1. Install and activate AISchemaGen
  2. Create a free account at aischemagen.com and copy your API key
  3. Paste the API key into the plugin settings
  4. Open any post or page in the WordPress editor
  5. Click Generate with AI from the AISchemaGen meta box
  6. Schema markup is generated, validated, and saved automatically

See the full getting started guide for detailed instructions.

Why AISchemaGen?

  • 30 seconds to generate complete schema markup instead of 10+ minutes manually
  • AI-powered content analysis — detects the right schema type automatically
  • 827+ schema types — Article, Product, LocalBusiness, FAQ, Recipe, Event, and every type on schema.org
  • Built-in validation — checks against schema.org specifications and Google’s Rich Results requirements
  • Google Rich Results Test integration — one-click validation inside WordPress
  • Universal — works with any theme, page builder, and content type

Free Features

  • 30 AI Generations per Month — Let AI analyze your content and generate schema automatically
  • All 827+ Schema Types — Article, Product, Recipe, FAQ, HowTo, Event, LocalBusiness, Service, Organization, Person, Course, VideoObject, ImageObject, Breadcrumb, Review, and more
  • Visual Editor — Edit schema fields with a user-friendly visual interface
  • Code Editor — Full JSON-LD code editing for advanced users
  • Live Preview — See your schema markup rendered in real-time as you edit
  • Built-in Validation — Ensure your schema is valid before publishing
  • Google Rich Results Test Integration — One-click test against Google’s validator
  • Template Library — Get started fast with pre-built schema templates
  • Export/Import — Move schemas between posts or sites
  • Single Site — Fully functional on a single WordPress installation

Pro Plan ($9.99/mo) — For Your Own Website

  • 300 AI Generations per Month
  • 100 Competitor URL Analyses per Month — Analyze competitor schemas for gap insights
  • Content Gap Analysis — See which schema types your competitors use that you don’t
  • Google Search Console Integration — Import real click and impression data
  • All free features included

Premium Plan ($29/mo) — For Client Work & Agencies

  • 1,000 AI Generations per Month
  • Unlimited Competitor URL Analyses
  • Multi-Site Support — Connect up to 5 WordPress sites (+$5/extra site)
  • Team Seats — 3 team members included (+$5/extra seat)
  • Bulk Generation — Generate or update schemas for 100+ posts at once
  • Schema Analytics Dashboard — Track rich result performance, impressions, clicks, and CTR

sections.installation:
From the WordPress Plugin Directory

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for AISchemaGen
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Go to AISchemaGen in the admin sidebar
  5. Create a free account at aischemagen.com to get your API key
  6. Paste your API key in the Settings page

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip from wordpress.org/plugins/digitalstorks-schema-gen
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the zip and activate

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • MySQL 5.7 or higher / MariaDB 10.3 or higher

📖 Full installation guide: aischemagen.com/docs#installation
sections.faq:
What is schema markup?

Schema markup (structured data) is code added to your website that helps search engines understand your content. It can result in rich snippets in search results, such as star ratings, prices, FAQ accordions, recipe cards, event details, and more.

Do I need an API key?

Yes. Create a free account at aischemagen.com — it takes 30 seconds. The free account gives you 30 AI generations per month at no cost. Copy your API key and paste it into the plugin Settings page.

Will this slow down my site?

No. AISchemaGen outputs lightweight JSON-LD in the page <head>. The admin interface uses React but is only loaded in the WordPress dashboard — it is never loaded on your front end.

Is the generated schema valid?

AISchemaGen includes built-in validation that checks your markup against schema.org specifications and Google’s Rich Results requirements. You can also test with Google’s Rich Results Test in one click directly inside the plugin.

Does it work with Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

Yes. AISchemaGen suppresses competing schema output from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO to prevent duplicate structured data. Your existing Yoast/Rank Math settings are untouched — only the schema output is managed by AISchemaGen.

Can I use it on multiple sites?

The Pro plan supports 1 site. The Premium plan supports 5 sites, with additional sites available at +$5/site. Each WordPress site needs its own API key.

What AI models are used?

All plans use GPT-4o Mini, OpenAI’s fast and efficient model. Your content is never used for AI model training.

What happens if I exceed my monthly limit?

You can still manually create and edit schemas using the visual editor or code editor. Only AI-powered generation counts toward the monthly limit. Upgrade your plan at any time from aischemagen.com/billing.

Where can I find detailed documentation?

Full documentation including installation guides, feature walkthroughs, schema type references, and troubleshooting is available at aischemagen.com/docs.

Where do I report bugs or request features?

Use the WordPress.org support forum for public issues, or email support@aischemagen.com for account-related questions.
sections.changelog:
1.1.3

  • Added: Suppress third-party admin notices (Elementor, Yoast, Rank Math, WooCommerce, etc.) on all AISchemaGen admin pages — plugin pages now stay clean without interruptions from unrelated plugin banners
  • Updated: Pricing restructured around individual vs agency use case — Free (“Try it out”), Pro (“For your own website”, $9.99/mo), Premium (“For client work & agencies”, $29/mo)
  • Updated: In-plugin upgrade and comparison pages rebuilt to reflect new pricing, competitor URL analysis limits (10/100/unlimited), and agency add-on model (+$5/site, +$5/seat)

1.1.2

  • Added: Full schema suppression for Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO — AISchemaGen now takes complete ownership of JSON-LD output to eliminate duplicate structured data
  • Added: Elementor “Schema AI Status” widget — shows active schema type(s) for the current page, visible only in the editor
  • Changed: Admin menu label and meta box title updated from “Schema AI” to “AISchemaGen” to align with branding across the SaaS platform and plugin directory
  • Removed: Gutenberg block registration (assets were not built); meta box in the post editor continues to work as before
  • Removed: AI Settings section (AI Provider, Free Model, Premium Model) from the Settings page — AI is fully handled by the AISchemaGen backend

1.1.1

  • Fixed: Bulk generation now uses backend-driven processing — the SaaS backend calls the WordPress REST API directly for each post using a BullMQ worker, eliminating the unreliable wp-cron approach
  • Fixed: Blank screen on setup wizard step 3 — removed invalid wp_safe_redirect/exit that prevented the page from rendering
  • Added: X-Schema-AI-Key authentication on the generate endpoint — allows the SaaS backend to call the REST API using the API key stored in plugin settings
  • Added: “Not a local business” dismiss button on the Business Info banner — clicking saves the flag and permanently hides the banner
  • Changed: Bulk generation poll interval reduced from 60 seconds to 15 seconds for faster progress feedback

1.0.1

  • Updated plugin name to AISchemaGen
  • Improved WordPress.org guideline compliance
  • Documentation improvements

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • All 827+ schema types with AI-powered generation
  • Visual editor, code editor, and live preview
  • Google Rich Results Test integration
  • Template library with export/import
  • WooCommerce, Yoast SEO, Rank Math, Elementor, Gutenberg, and ACF integrations
  • Basic validation and analytics
  • Free tier with 30 AI generations per month
